referenceFunction.generalComment: All measured emissions are taken from an old (1993) EMPA report. The type of power saw probably does not correspond to the type described in the infrastructure, but this discrepancy can be accepted. Data on the use of fuel and lubricating oil are specific for the Korporation Giswil, which delivers the wood to Walter Küng AG for the production of holzpur elements. Lubricating oil is modelled by soya oil. Correcting modules for the transport of soya oil are applied. Air and oil emissions are scaled to the use of fuel and lubricating oil.; UUID: b00ca865-2cee-3c7a-971b-d15a6b200175
